scenes.text: The flight landed safely and everyone disembarked.
The log shows the same flight landing twice, forty minutes apart.
Same airport. Same gate. Same passengers.
The second entry lists one extra passenger, unnamed.
The aircraft has since flown thousands of times without incident.
Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
